plan.question: Does local depth training coverage, rather than merely more updates, repair the frozen FNO response within a fixed budget?

scientific_plan.question: Does local depth training coverage, rather than merely more updates, repair the frozen FNO response within a fixed budget?
scientific_plan.initialization: Both arms load the identical original width8 final state_dict; verify identical parameter hashes and predictions at update0. Reset Adam in both arms; do not reuse old optimizer momentum.
scientific_plan.fixed: Same model architecture, a=.5, source0, stored physical labels, IEEE policy, training wavefield/trace scales, field+receiver loss, Adam lr.001,300 total updates per arm, same index cycle0/1/2, no augmentation.
scientific_plan.only_main_change: Training geometry distribution: three copies of nominal state versus -2/0/+2. Each arm300 exposures,100 per slot; nominal exposure counts differ as intended distribution intervention.
scientific_plan.training_data: Reuse prior three physical states from depth audit raw.pt; no new physical training labels. Validation +/-1 from interpolation raw.pt is never included in gradient updates.
scientific_plan.validation_role: Previously used diagnostic development states, not fresh final testing. Purpose is controlled learning mechanism, not independent generalization certification.
scientific_plan.stop_rule: Run exactly300 per arm; final300 primary. No best checkpoint selection, validation early stopping, truth-informed clipping or threshold changes. Preserve both intermediate states and failures.
metrics: Separate train/dev complete/scattered field/receiver errors for every state
Dev +/-1 finite geometry receiver response error/norm ratio/cosine
Actual updates,exposures,losses,gradient finiteness,state hashes,reload parity,per-arm time and peak memory
Nominal contrasts .3/.7 at updates0/300 as descriptive forgetting checks only; no training or stopping based on these
baselines: Frozen train-only depth linear direct and snapshot versions
Nearest depth and zero scatter retained
scientific_plan.causal_screen: At final300 coverage arm must have lower scatter field and receiver error on both dev states and lower dev response relative error than nominal-repeat arm; also meet inherited both-state20% errors and response20%/cos.90 screens. Improvement without absolute screen is partial evidence only.
scientific_plan.neural_utility_gate: Separately compare coverage arm to frozen depth linear baselines on both errors and response plus accounted preparation/training/inference costs. Passing coverage screen alone does not establish neural superiority or total inversion cost benefit.

decisions.coverage_repairs_and_repeat_does_not: Supports local geometry coverage as a cause within identical architecture/start/budget; keep simple interpolation unless neural benefit is separately demonstrated.
decisions.both_repair_similarly: More updates/nominal fitting may suffice, coverage-specific mechanism not established.
decisions.coverage_improves_but_fails_screens: Partial coverage effect; no automatic more epochs. Inspect train fit and representation before a new budget.
decisions.neither_repairs: This300-step intervention does not establish a repair; distinguish training fit from dev response, not capacity conclusion.

scientific_plan.budget: 600 total optimizer updates; estimated4-6min, cap8min for paired training/evaluation, no downloads or data regeneration; stop on OOM/nonfinite, no grid/mode/precision reduction. Separate fixed-state reload verification allowed.
scientific_plan.scope: Local fixed-shape/source0 depth family at a=.5; supplied geometry forward task, no blind localization, material inversion, physical material Jacobian or independent final test.

plan.recovery_only: Same paired intervention; do not alter architecture, loss, data, scales, optimizer hyperparameters, sample order, evaluation schedule or screens.
plan.nominal_repeat: Load verified checkpoint150 including optimizer moments and step counters; run exactly updates151..300, same nominal sample cycle. Do not reset optimizer in this resumed arm. Check update150 state/prediction parity before continuation.
plan.depth_coverage: Load original width8 final state_dict, new Adam as initially planned; run exactly300 updates cycling depth -2/0/+2. Check its initial parameters and predictions against original nominal arm update0.
plan.data_role: All existing diagnostics remain development. No new physical labels, no final test, no validation gradients.
plan.evaluations: Nominal150 parity then300 primary; coverage0/150/300. Keep final300 primary even if150 is better.
plan.storage: Convert state_dict and optimizer state recursively to CPU; write each checkpoint to a fresh temporary path, load with weights_only and verify tensors and optimizer step/exposure counters, then rename to a unique final path. Never overwrite old broken checkpoint or prior results. Save loss/progress every25 updates; CPU checkpoint at150/300, plus verified restart on timeout if possible.
plan.preflight: Record free disk space and test CPU save/load before training; GPU/source/dependency hashes match prior run. Any write failure stops the run and is not interpreted scientifically.
plan.resource_accounting: Prior stdout reached300 nominal updates but only150 safely checkpointed; recovery repeats150 discarded updates. Across attempts expect750 executed optimizer updates (300 prior+450 recovery), not600 free-compute total. Account failed saving, replay/QA and historical data/training separately; elapsed original training log lower bound302.1sec.
plan.budget: 450 new updates, expected7-9min under observed IEEE execution rate; cap10min with storage preflight included, no downloads/label generation. Save partial progress and stop on cap/OOM/nonfinite/write errors. This revised recovery budget is explicit; not executed in the current turn.
plan.decision: Use unchanged original causal screen and neural utility gate only after both final300 states are safely saved and reloaded; intermediate or single-arm results cannot replace the paired primary.

storage: CPU copies; write flush fsync, weights_only reload/all tensor equality before unique-path replace
execution: Same IEEE policy and loss/input arithmetic as frozen paired experiment; fresh Adam only coverage arm
